name: dogfood-socketio-notification
description: Dogfood app 3 (v1.13-5) — a Socket.io / SSE notification app that exercises server-to-client push, room-scoped delivery, reconnect + pending-event replay and queue-overflow backpressure across a provider-neutral interface, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls socket.io-client when SOCKETIO_URL is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/realtime createSocketioMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.
